question: If Delta ABC sim Delta QRP,frac{{ar(Delta ABC)}}{{ar(Delta QRP)}} = (9)/(4), AB = 18 cm, BC = 15 cm, then the length of PR is _________.
solution:
**Given **

Delta ABC sim Delta QRP,frac{{ar(Delta ABC)}}{{ar(Delta QRP)}} = (9)/(4)

AB=18cm

BC=15cm 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e4bd0b7d98ea8ecb4c2102340f0699afb21009665797e745b80c5f6b7bb5250.png] 

**Calculation**

using similarity of triangles 

frac{{ar(Delta ABC)}}{{ar(Delta QRP)}} = (9)/(4)=((AB)/(QR))²

(AB)/(QR)=(3)/(2)

.(AB)/(QR)=(BC)/(RP)=(AC)/(QP)

(3)/(2)=(15)/(RP) so RP=10cm

**The length of RP is 10cm**
